metadata.title: Country Music Album Cover with Fire and Fringe

retrievalProfile.description: A dramatic cinematic portrait featuring a central female figure in a fringe dress standing next to a burning vehicle, characterized by a warm sepia-toned palette and bold, layered typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central full-length portrait of a woman in a textured fringe dress, positioned to the right of a car engulfed in flames. The scene is set at night with a warm, monochromatic sepia and gold color grade, framed by a thick border and featuring large-scale, semi-transparent display typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned right-of-center balanced by the bright fire on the left
Warm glow from the fire illuminating the subject's side and hair
Large-scale typography layered behind the subject's head and in the foreground
Thick outer border framing the entire composition
coreInvariants: High-contrast lighting sourced from the fire
Textured fringe elements on the subject's clothing

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-length female figure, slightly right of center, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white-hot flames of the burning car on the left side.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bright fire, moves right to the subject's face, then down to the foreground text, and up to the background header text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, textured ground and night sky provide breathing room around the central action.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep sepia and burnt umber for shadows and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white and pale yellow for the fire and highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted gold for the border and foreground text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between the dark night and the intense firelight.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold, condensed sans-serif with geometric proportions.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different scales and transparency levels.
graphicDevices: Small icon/logo centered above main text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, and bold presence of the display text.
Provides the clean, geometric, condensed look required for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic night scene with a woman in a tan fringe dress standing next to a car on fire. Apply a heavy sepia and gold color grade. Ensure the fire is the primary light source.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large condensed uppercase text behind the woman's head with a semi-transparent gradient. Add smaller, solid gold condensed text in the bottom left corner. Frame the entire image with a thick gold border.

verificationChecks: Is the main text layered behind the subject?
Is the color palette strictly warm sepia and gold?
Is the fire the brightest element in the composition?
Is the border thick and consistent?

adjustableVariables: Density of the fringe on the dress
postGenerationChecks: Check that the fire light reflects realistically on the subject.
Ensure the text behind the subject is still readable.
Verify the sepia tone is consistent across the border and image.
Confirm the fringe texture is visible and detailed.
recipe.reuseFormula: Cinematic Portrait + Fire Light Source + Sepia Grade + Condensed Layered Typography
